questions.text: What are the security requirements for this project: data types handled, storage location, encryption standards, access controls, and incident response procedure?
questions.why: Security requirements are mandatory to design a compliant solution and protect sensitive customer data.

questions.text: What is the approved total budget or budget range for this proposal?
questions.why: Budget is essential to determine pricing strategy, scope boundaries, team allocation, and feasibility.

questions.text: What payment terms are expected (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, milestone-based, upfront deposit percentage)?
questions.why: Payment terms are required for contractual agreement and financial planning on both sides.

questions.text: What are the key assumptions for this project: team capacity availability, data quality/readiness, system integration dependencies, and any scope exclusions?
questions.why: Documenting assumptions prevents scope creep, manages risk, and ensures both parties have aligned expectations.

questions.text: Can you share case studies, references, or work samples demonstrating similar automation capability in quote response or document generation?
questions.why: Proof of relevant prior work builds confidence in the proposed solution and demonstrates applicable expertise.
